steps.step: settings update (daily limit 100000 so price tests are not capped)
create V1 (promo price, 9 codes) + CSV import
voucher detail V1 after rejected import
CSV import: in-file duplicate rejected, nothing committed
create V2..V8 (flash, last-unit, insufficient, cheap, shared, survey-rule, flash-whole-stock)
flash conflicts: price >= regular, quota > unreserved, start in past
create Flash F1 (V2: 5 in stock, quota 3), F2 (V7, survey rule), F3 (V8: quota = whole stock 2)
flash overlap on the same voucher rejected
A: quote -> redeem V1 -> replay same key -> by-key
redeem used quote with a new key
same key + different quote -> IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT; same quote + new key -> QUOTE_ALREADY_REDEEMED
C redeems V1, D redeems shared V6 (tickets for the faulty-code flow)
list by tab, detail with code, use, undo
another user's ticket is not found
SOLD_OUT: last unit taken between quote and confirm (V3)
B redeem V1 at stale price
PRICE_CHANGED: Admin changes price between quote and confirm (V1)
INSUFFICIENT_POINTS: balance spent between quote and confirm (V4 then V5)
VOUCHER_UNAVAILABLE: Admin pauses after quote (V4), then hide -> not found at quote
stock adjust: below issued+reserved rejected; increase without codes rejected; decrease ok
wait for F1, F2, F3 reserved_at (lifecycle job)
D redeem flash quote after sell-out (regular stock left)
Flash: A,B,C,D quote FLASH; A,B,C redeem; per-user cap; D loses (PRICE_CHANGED to regular price); sale sold out
Flash where quota = whole stock (stock_remaining 0 after reserve): first redeem succeeds
A quote V7 (flash needs a recent survey)
end F2 reason OTHER without note
Flash F2: ACCOUNT_NOT_ELIGIBLE NO_RECENT_SURVEY; Admin ends early; unsold quota returns
users report: A (V1), C (V1), D (V6 shared); duplicate report refused
Admin queue lists them; canReplace and reason; no code value in payloads
REJECT: note required; REPLACE refused for shared code; REJECT with note; already resolved
REPLACE: user gets a different code; replay is idempotent; refund after replace refused
REFUND: RFD- reference, wallet restored, history REFUNDED
faulty-code notifications reach A, C and D
each SUCCEEDED redemption has exactly one journal keyed redemption:{userId}:{key}, linked via journal_id
each refund has exactly one journal keyed redemption-refund:{reportId}, linked via journal_id
stock_total = stock_remaining + flash reserved + issued (per voucher)
each code assigned at most once
ledger accounts: no balance drift, no negative user account
